nameEn: Manufacture of bicycles and invalid carriages
description: This class includes the manufacture of non-motorised bicycles and invalid carriages.
includes: manufacture of non-motorised bicycles and other cycles: racing bicycles, mountain bicycles, BMX bicycles, children's bicycles
manufacture of invalid carriages, with or without motor
manufacture of parts and accessories for bicycles and invalid carriages: frames, forks, saddles, pedals, chains, brakes, handlebars, wheels
excludes: manufacture of motorcycles and mopeds, see 3091
